intro: Ethiopia has over 120 million people, the second most in Africa.

chapters.title: Peoples and faiths
text: The Oromo and Amhara are the largest groups; others include the Somali, Tigrayans and Sidama. Amharic is the main working language, with Oromo, Tigrinya and others also official. Most people are Orthodox Christian or Muslim.
Ethiopia uses its own calendar, which is about seven to eight years behind the Western one, and has 13 months.

chapters.title: Addis Ababa
text: Addis Ababa ('new flower') hosts the African Union.
